auth.label: API Key
auth.description: People Data Labs API key used with the X-Api-Key header. Create and manage API keys in the People Data Labs API Dashboard: https://dashboard.peopledatalabs.com.

actions.name: enrich_company
actions.description: Match a single company in People Data Labs and return the top matched company record.

anyOf.description: People Data Labs company identifier to enrich.

pdl_id.description: People Data Labs company identifier to enrich.

anyOf.description: Company name.
Company social profile URL.
Company stock ticker.
Company website or domain.
Full or partial company location.
Company locality.
Company state or region.
Company country.
Company street address.
Company postal code.

pretty.description: Whether to return human-readable JSON indentation.

include_if_matched.description: Whether to include top-level matched field metadata in the response.

min_likelihood.description: Likelihood score returned by People Data Labs.

anyOf.description: Boolean expression describing fields that must exist for the response to count as a match.

required.description: Boolean expression describing fields that must exist for the response to count as a match.

titlecase.description: Whether text fields in successful responses should be title-cased.

anyOf.description: Comma-separated fields to include, or prefixed with - to exclude fields.

data_include.description: Comma-separated fields to include, or prefixed with - to exclude fields.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for enriching a single company with People Data Labs. pdl_id, name, profile, ticker, or website is required.

status.description: People Data Labs status code returned for the enrichment request.

likelihood.description: Likelihood score returned by People Data Labs.

data.description: Company record returned by People Data Labs using the official Company Schema field names.

matched.description: Field match metadata returned by People Data Labs when include_if_matched is enabled.

outputSchema.description: Normalized People Data Labs company enrichment response.

actions.name: enrich_person
actions.description: Match a single person in People Data Labs and return the top matched person record.

anyOf.description: People Data Labs person identifier to enrich.

pdl_id.description: People Data Labs person identifier to enrich.

anyOf.description: Person full name, including at least the first and last name when provided.

name.description: Person full name, including at least the first and last name when provided.

anyOf.description: Person first name.
Person last name.
Person middle name.
Location where the person lives.
Street address where the person lives.

street_address.description: Street address where the person lives.

anyOf.description: Locality where the person lives.
State or region where the person lives.

region.description: State or region where the person lives.

anyOf.description: Country where the person lives.
Postal code where the person lives.

postal_code.description: Postal code where the person lives.

anyOf.description: Company name, website, or social URL where the person has worked.

company.description: Company name, website, or social URL where the person has worked.

anyOf.description: School name, website, or social URL the person attended.

school.description: School name, website, or social URL the person attended.

anyOf.description: Phone number the person has used, including the country code prefix.

phone.description: Phone number the person has used, including the country code prefix.

anyOf.description: Email address the person has used.

email.description: Email address the person has used.

anyOf.description: SHA-256 or MD5 hash of the person's email.

email_hash.description: SHA-256 or MD5 hash of the person's email.

anyOf.description: Social profile URL the person has used.

profile.description: Social profile URL the person has used.

anyOf.description: LinkedIn ID of the person.
Birth year or full birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

birth_date.description: Birth year or full birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

pretty.description: Whether to return human-readable JSON indentation.

include_if_matched.description: Whether to include top-level matched field metadata in the response.

min_likelihood.description: Likelihood score returned by People Data Labs.

anyOf.description: Boolean expression describing fields that must exist for the response to count as a match.

required.description: Boolean expression describing fields that must exist for the response to count as a match.

titlecase.description: Whether text fields in successful responses should be title-cased.

anyOf.description: Comma-separated fields to include, or prefixed with - to exclude fields.

data_include.description: Comma-separated fields to include, or prefixed with - to exclude fields.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for enriching a single person with People Data Labs. Provide pdl_id, profile, email, phone, email_hash, lid, or a name plus locality, region, company, school, location, or postal_code.

status.description: People Data Labs status code returned for the enrichment request.

likelihood.description: Likelihood score returned by People Data Labs.

data.description: Person record returned by People Data Labs using the official Person Schema field names.

matched.description: Field match metadata returned by People Data Labs when include_if_matched is enabled.

outputSchema.description: Normalized People Data Labs person enrichment response.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.description: Search the People Data Labs company dataset with either an Elasticsearch query or SQL query.

anyOf.description: Elasticsearch v7.7 query string encoded as JSON text.

query.description: Elasticsearch v7.7 query string encoded as JSON text.

anyOf.description: SQL query of the form SELECT * FROM the matching dataset WHERE ...

sql.description: SQL query of the form SELECT * FROM the matching dataset WHERE ...

size.description: Maximum number of matched records to return.

from.description: Legacy offset for paginating between batches.

anyOf.description: Offset token returned by a previous People Data Labs search response.

scroll_token.description: Offset token returned by a previous People Data Labs search response.

titlecase.description: Whether returned records should be title-cased.

pretty.description: Whether to return human-readable JSON indentation.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for searching the People Data Labs company dataset. Exactly one of query or sql is required, and from cannot be used with scroll_token.

status.description: People Data Labs status code returned for the search request.

total.description: Number of records matching the People Data Labs search.

items.description: Company record returned by People Data Labs using the official Company Schema field names.

data.description: Matched company records returned by People Data Labs.

anyOf.description: Scroll token for fetching the next page of matched companies.

scroll_token.description: Scroll token for fetching the next page of matched companies.

outputSchema.description: Normalized People Data Labs company search response.
